title: billingInvoice
description: EWDS topic published by the Billing & Payment Service (Blooo, T5.6) for every issued or updated invoice. One invoice covers the settled trades between one consumer and one producer for a billing period (or an early settlement); it is issued by the platform in the name of the producer (self-billing). Derived from int:Invoice (schemas/v1.0.0/billing/Invoice.json) with billing extensions. Contains no personal data: parties are Actor UUIDs only; the legal invoice number, PSP data and grid fees are not published. DRAFT proposed by Blooo to EWAG.

invoiceId.description: Primary identifier, shared identifier on EWDS. IRI: int:invoiceId. UUID v4.

billingId.description: FK to the Billing record of the consumer for the period. IRI: int:billingId. UUID v4.

communityId.description: [Extension] FK to the Community. UUID v4.

billingMode.description: [Extension] live = real money; virtual = computed and paid in the payment provider's test environment only (all communities in D5.5 V1).

settlementType.description: [Extension] periodic = end-of-period invoice; early = early settlement requested by the consumer; final = forced invoice (year end or participant exit).

billingPeriodFrom.description: [Extension] Start of the period covered (inclusive). ISO 8601 with timezone.

billingPeriodUntil.description: [Extension] End of the period covered (exclusive). ISO 8601 with timezone.

invoiceIssuedTo.description: FK to the consumer Actor (payer). IRI: int:invoiceIssuedTo. UUID v4.

invoiceIssuedBy.description: FK to the producer Actor (seller). The invoice is issued by the platform in the producer's name (self-billing). IRI: int:invoiceIssuedBy. UUID v4.

selfBilling.description: [Extension] true when the invoice is issued by the platform on behalf of the producer under a self-billing mandate.

totalEnergyKWh.description: [Extension] Net energy covered by the invoice in kWh (after netting between the two parties).

totalAmount.description: energyAmount + taxAmount (gridFeeAmount is 0 in D5.5). IRI: int:totalAmount.

energyAmount.description: Net energy amount between the two parties. IRI: int:energyAmount.

gridFeeAmount.description: IRI: int:gridFeeAmount. Always 0 in D5.5: grid fees, taxes and levies stay on the supplier/DSO bill (assumption A20).

taxAmount.description: VAT on the energy amount (rate per community, 0 by default). IRI: int:taxAmount.

vatRate.description: [Extension] VAT rate applied, as a fraction (e.g. 0.23).

carriedForwardAmount.description: [Extension] Amount carried forward from previous periods (below the minimum threshold) and included in this invoice.

currency.description: ISO 4217, community currency. One invoice has one currency. IRI: int:currency.

exchangeRate.description: [Extension] Conversion applied when trade prices (EUR) differ from the invoice currency; null otherwise.

tradeIds.description: FKs to the settled trades covered (both directions when netted). IRI: int:tradeIds.

items.description: Trade identifier as published by GSY DEX: UUID v4 or 16-byte hex (0x + 32 hex chars, GSY DEX v2 on-chain id).

paymentIds.description: FKs to Payments for this invoice. IRI: int:paymentIds. UUID v4 array.
